title: TAT-3264 — perps market detail orders section top spacing
description: Proves the orders section header on the extension perps market detail page uses the same top spacing token (paddingTop=16px) as the stats section header, and that with no open orders the orders section does not render. Builds real testnet order state through the order-entry UI.
pre_conditions: Account 1 (0x8dc623…9003) funded for Hyperliquid testnet perps

setup-clean.intent: Switch to testnet and open the ETH market (explicit order cleanup happens below)

setup-reload-a.intent: Reload the market detail after the testnet switch so the perps context is active

setup-close.intent: Cancel any leftover orders from the market page (reliable cancel context)

setup-wait-absent.intent: Poll the live orders cache until zero ETH orders remain

setup-reload-b.intent: Reload again so the DOM reflects the confirmed empty-orders state

setup-wait-market.intent: Wait for the market detail to render

ac2-measure-empty.intent: Measure section state with no open orders

ac2-assert-rendered.intent: Market detail is rendered (stats section present)

ac2-assert-absent.intent: With no open orders the orders section header is absent (no regression to empty state)

ac2-focus.intent: Bring the market detail tab to the foreground for the screenshot

ac2-screenshot-empty.intent: Capture empty-state market detail (orders section not rendered)
ac2-screenshot-empty.note: AC2: no open orders — orders section does not render

ac1-nav-trade.intent: Open the order entry page to place a resting limit order

ac1-wait-entry.intent: Wait for the order entry page

ac1-place-order.intent: Switch to Limit, fill price/size into the real React inputs, click the real submit button, and confirm the order rests (retried for testnet flakiness)

ac1-assert-order.intent: Wait for and confirm the real open order before leaving the trade page

ac1-nav-market.intent: Open the market detail fresh (reload) so the orders section renders reliably

ac1-wait-stats.intent: Wait for the market detail to render (stats header present)

ac1-wait-orders.intent: Wait for the orders section header to be visible

ac1-scroll-orders.intent: Bring the orders section header into view

ac1-measure.intent: Measure orders vs stats header top padding via getComputedStyle + getBoundingClientRect

ac1-assert-padding.intent: Orders header top padding equals the 16px section spacing token

ac1-assert-match.intent: Orders header top padding equals the stats header top padding (same spacing convention)

ac1-focus.intent: Bring the market detail tab to the foreground for the screenshot

ac1-screenshot-orders.intent: Capture the orders section with correct top spacing
ac1-screenshot-orders.note: AC1: orders section top spacing matches adjacent sections (16px)

teardown-nav-market.intent: Ensure the market detail is active before cancelling the order

teardown-close.intent: Cancel the testnet limit order created by this recipe

teardown-wait-absent.intent: Poll the live orders cache until zero ETH orders remain

teardown-state.intent: Return to the wallet home (order cleanup already done above)

teardown-done.intent: Recipe passed: orders section spacing matches convention
